transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
Hello! I'm Dora, and I've just completed your post-cataract surgery follow-up check. 

Do you have any questions about your surgery or your recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Hi Dora! Yes, I do have a few questions. First, I'm wondering when I can start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
That's a great question! You can start doing light gardening after 1 week following your surgery. However, you should avoid any strenuous or heavy exercise for about a month after your operation.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thank you for clarifying that. Yes, I do have another question. When can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
Good question. If you were using eye gel or drops for dry eyes before your surgery, it's safe to continue using them unless you've been told otherwise by your doctor.

However, if you need new supplies, your GP should be able to provide some more for you.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thanks for the information! I have another concern: I'm feeling very sensitive to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
It's quite normal for your eyes to be a bit sensitive to light as they adjust to your new lenses. If it's mild and things just seem brighter than you're used to, I'd recommend wearing sunglasses when you go outside.

However, if you're experiencing significant pain in bright light, or if your eye is also red and painful, that's not normal and we may need to assess it further. In that case, please contact your care team.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thank you, that makes me feel better. I do have one last question. Should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
That's a good question. It's quite common for vision to not be completely clear in the first week after surgery, and it should improve quickly and settle down over time.

How long ago was your surgery? If your vision is still blurry beyond that first week, or if it's getting significantly worse, we may need to check it to make sure everything is okay.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thanks for the explanation. My surgery was about a week ago, so that helps. I don't have any more questions right now. I really appreciate your help!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: That's wonderful! I'm glad I could help. Just to confirm - have all your questions about your cataract surgery recovery been answered today?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, all of my questions have been answered. Thank you so much for your assistance!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You're very welcome! Take care, and wishing you a smooth recovery.

verdict.label: pass

In that case, please contact your care team."
